## Jardim da Amazônia Lodge: nature in the southern Amazon

**Jardim da Amazônia Lodge** is located in Mato Grosso state, near São José do Rio Claro. It is a forest lodge on the transition between **the Amazon and the Cerrado**, two major natural regions of [Brazil](/brazil/). It is an ideal base for exploring the forest on foot, birdwatching and discovering riverbanks with local guides.

For travelers, the most interesting feature is the difference between neighboring habitats. Forest, riverside vegetation and more open areas can be found relatively close together. Nature watching here is not limited to a single panorama or one spectacular safari photograph.

## Where is Jardim da Amazônia?

The lodge is in the **São José do Rio Claro** area at the southern edge of the Amazon biome, in central Brazil. This is not Manaus, nor a traditional journey along the wide waterways of the northern Amazon. The main landmarks here are Mato Grosso's roads, smaller rivers and the forest surrounding the lodge.

Traveling from [Cuiabá](/brazil/place/cuiaba/) takes part of a day, depending on the roads and stops. On Ada Tours' Three Ecosystems in Eight Days itinerary, guests arrive at the lodge after an overland journey on day one; the next day is devoted to forest and water-based activities.

This sequence is convenient: check in and rest after the drive first, then explore nature without having to set out on another transfer immediately.

## Activities in the surrounding forest

Forest walks offer opportunities to study vegetation, look for animal tracks and listen to birds. On the trail, the most interesting discoveries are often small details rather than large mammals: fruit trees, vines, signs of animal activity and changes in plant life between dry and damp areas.

The lodge offers excursion formats involving birdwatching and observing primates. However, **no particular species can be scheduled to appear**. Sightings depend on the season, weather, time of day and animal behavior.

If ornithology is a major reason for your visit, describe your interests in advance: a general introductory walk and specialist birdwatching with binoculars, photographic equipment or a target species list require different amounts of time. Early-morning hours are worth reserving, as some birds are particularly active then.

## Rio Claro and canoe trips

A key natural feature near the lodge is the **[Rio Claro](/brazil/place/rio-claro-jardim-amazonia/)**. On water excursions, you can view riverside forests from a different level, look for birds near the water and see trees reflected in calm sections of the river.

On Ada Tours' [eight-day eco-tour](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/), the second day includes a forest walk, time to relax and **canoeing along Rio Claro toward Anaconda Lake**. Check the actual tour itinerary: the lodge's own activities and the services included in a particular package are not necessarily the same.

On the water, follow your guide's instructions and use required life-saving equipment. Do not feed wild animals or attempt to bring them closer to the canoe for photographs.

## How this part of the Amazon differs from the Pantanal

These are two different nature experiences that can conveniently be combined in one journey.

| Region | What to observe |
|---|---|
| Jardim da Amazônia | Forest, birds, Rio Claro |
| [Bom Jardim](/brazil/place/bom-jardim/) | Clear pools and nature |
| [Pantanal](/brazil/place/pantanal/) | Seasonally flooded plains |

In the southern Amazon, much wildlife is concealed by vegetation, so attention turns to sounds, tracks and birdwatching in the forest. In the Pantanal, many landscapes are more open and affected by seasonal river flooding. That changes both travel logistics and where animals are sought.

The three-ecosystems route also crosses [Chapada dos Guimarães](/brazil/place/chapada-dos-guimaraes/), with its sandstone slopes and plateau scenery. The three stages reveal different environments within Mato Grosso state.

## When to visit and how to prepare

Mato Grosso has distinct wet and drier seasons. According to the lodge itself, **May to September** tends to bring firmer trails, while **October to April** is generally rainier, with changing water levels. That does not mean every day has the same weather or that particular wildlife sightings are guaranteed.

For forest walks, bring closed-toe shoes, lightweight long-sleeved clothes, insect repellent and rain protection. Photographers will find waterproof covers, spare batteries and protection against humidity useful.

Before booking, check meals, excursion types, room category, guiding and transport for your selected program. The [three-ecosystems eco-tour page](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/) describes the terms of that particular journey, not all possible stays at the lodge.

## Frequently asked questions about Jardim da Amazônia

### Is this lodge in the Amazon or the Pantanal?

It is on the southern edge of the Amazon, in the Amazon–Cerrado transition zone of Mato Grosso state. The Northern Pantanal is a separate stage of some itineraries.

### Can you see birds and monkeys?

The area around the lodge provides habitat for many birds and primates. Sightings depend on nature and season, so specific species are not guaranteed.

### Can you stay at the lodge without a tour?

The lodge has its own accommodation and visiting arrangements. Check the days and inclusions of the Ada Tours itinerary separately from the lodge's offers.

### How much time should you allow for nature activities?

A proper forest walk and a water outing require more time than a brief stop. The current eight-day itinerary allocates an arrival day and a separate nature day to this area.

## Which tours visit Jardim da Amazônia Lodge?

We offer {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} with a required visit to [Jardim da Amazônia Lodge](/brazil/place/jardim-da-amazonia/). Currently, this is [Amazon, Savanna and Pantanal: Three Ecosystems in Eight Days](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/). The journey starts and ends in Cuiabá, connecting three different natural regions of Mato Grosso state.

Two nights at the lodge allow for a full day in the forest rather than a quick stop along the road. The next stages focus on clear rivers and the Cerrado savanna, followed by the wetlands of the [Pantanal](/brazil/place/pantanal/). Travelers choose this trip for the changing natural landscapes and outdoor activities.

**Important when choosing:** accommodation at Jardim da Amazônia is included in a multi-day journey through Mato Grosso. This is not a standalone tour exclusively to the lodge or an offer of an independent stay without the other itinerary stages.

## Two days in the Amazon: the journey, forest and river

The first day includes a meeting at Cuiabá airport. According to the program, departure toward the forested part of the state is scheduled for 13:20 and the drive takes approximately 4.5 hours. After arrival, travelers check in at the lodge, have dinner and rest before the following day's nature activities.

Day two includes a walk along forest trails, an introduction to local vegetation and a water-based section. The canoe trip follows [Rio Claro](/brazil/place/rio-claro-jardim-amazonia/) toward [Anaconda Lake](/brazil/place/anaconda-lake-jardim-amazonia/). It offers an opportunity to experience the southern Amazon both from the riverbank and from the water: beneath the tree canopy, alongside overgrown banks and on calm stretches of the river.

The lodge is in the São José do Rio Claro area, in the transition between the Amazon and the Cerrado. The surrounding nature is known for birdwatching and observing primates. Wild animal encounters depend on the season, weather and their activity; no particular species can be guaranteed to appear during a walk.

The evening of day two includes a return to the lodge and dinner. On the morning of day three, the journey heads south to [Bom Jardim](/brazil/place/bom-jardim/).

## What comes after Jardim da Amazônia?

Over eight days, you experience more than one section of rainforest. Each subsequent region offers its own activities, which are worth considering when choosing a tour.

| Stage | Highlights |
|---|---|
| Amazon | Forest trails, canoeing, 2 nights at the lodge |
| Bom Jardim | Snorkeling in clear water |
| Chapada dos Guimarães | Cliffs, waterfalls and viewpoints |
| Northern Pantanal | Canoeing, walks and wildlife watching |

In [Bom Jardim](/brazil/place/bom-jardim/), the program includes snorkeling in clear water around the Salobra River. This is part of the tour; it would be incorrect to describe it as scuba diving.

Next comes [Chapada dos Guimarães](/brazil/place/chapada-dos-guimaraes/) and its [national park](/brazil/place/chapada-dos-guimaraes-national-park/): sandstone cliffs, waterfalls, lookout points and views of the Cerrado. Stops include [Bridal Veil waterfall](/brazil/place/veu-de-noiva-chapada/).

The final three nights are spent in the Northern Pantanal at Araras Eco Lodge. Activities include excursions on water and on foot, observation towers, horseback riding and a night safari. Birds and animals may be seen in their natural environment, but the species encountered cannot be known in advance.

This itinerary suits travelers comfortable with regular transfers and a variety of outdoor activities. If your main goal is a few relaxed days exclusively in the Amazon rainforest, compare it with [other Brazil tours](/brazil/tour/) and programs that devote most of their time to the Amazon.

## Duration, guiding, meals and price

The trip lasts **8 days and 7 nights**: two nights at Jardim da Amazônia, two at Park Eco Lodge and three at Araras. It includes transfers along the route, meals as specified in the daily itinerary and excursions with an English-speaking guide or naturalist. International and domestic flights are listed as expenses paid separately.

{{#if catalog.hasComparableUsdPrice}}
Prices for suitable programs start from {{catalog.minUsdPriceLabel}}. For a particular tour, the number of participants and included services matter: check them in the [itinerary description](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/).
{{/if}}

When traveling from Cuiabá, confirm your flight arrival time in advance: the first day's program specifies a departure time. On the final day, a transfer to Cuiabá airport is scheduled at one of two times depending on your flight.

Water-based activities depend on natural conditions. In the Pantanal, the canoe route may use an alternative river if another stretch is inaccessible because of weather or road conditions. The possibility of substitution is part of the tour terms, not a guarantee that both rivers will be visited.

## When to go and what to bring

The São José do Rio Claro area has distinct drier and rainy periods. According to the lodge, trails are generally easier to walk from May through September, while the forest is wetter from October to April. Jardim da Amazônia nevertheless welcomes visitors year-round. On a combined itinerary, travel dates also depend on road conditions and water-activity availability in the Pantanal.

For walks, bring closed-toe shoes with non-slip soles, lightweight long-sleeved clothes and protection against sun and insects. On a canoe, keep anything that must stay dry in a sealed bag. Binoculars are useful for birdwatching, while a long-lens camera can capture animals without approaching them.

Preparing for this trip is different from preparing for a sightseeing tour of Rio: much of each day is spent away from the hotel, and wildlife encounters cannot be scheduled to the minute. Learn more about the destination, its environment and location on the [Jardim da Amazônia Lodge page](/brazil/place/jardim-da-amazonia/).

## Frequently asked questions

### Is Jardim da Amazônia included or offered separately?

In the current catalog it is a required stop on the [eight-day Amazon, Cerrado and Pantanal route](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/). The program includes two nights at the lodge.

### Can you see animals on the walks?

The lodge is in a natural area where birds and primates are observed. Specific species, numbers and how close they appear depend on the day's conditions; sightings are not guaranteed.

### What language are the nature excursions conducted in?

The confirmed eight-day tour specifies an English-speaking guide or naturalist. It does not state that a Russian-speaking guide is provided.

### Are flights to Cuiabá included?

No. International and domestic flights are listed as paid separately. Transfers within the itinerary are included.

### Can the lodge be combined with the Pantanal?

Yes. That is exactly how the current route is organized: southern Amazon first, then Bom Jardim and Chapada dos Guimarães, followed by three nights in the Northern Pantanal.

## Jericoacoara: dunes, lagoons and ocean in northeastern Brazil

Jericoacoara is on Brazil's Atlantic coast in Ceará state. The small resort village is surrounded by sandy landscapes and national park land. Here you can spend relaxed days by the ocean, stroll over dunes, head to freshwater lagoons and choose water activities depending on the wind and sea conditions.

Jericoacoara's defining feature is **the proximity of the ocean coast, shifting dunes and lagoons**. A good trip here is therefore different from a standard vacation at a large resort hotel. Decide in advance whether you want to spend most of your time on one beach or are happy to explore the surrounding area.

## Jericoacoara National Park and natural attractions

The protected area around the village is known for coastal dunes, beaches and rocky landforms. Local landmarks include Pedra Furada, a natural rock with an opening, and Duna do Pôr do Sol, known for its sunset views. The park also has lagoons in different areas, whose size and accessibility depend on rainfall.

ICMBio, the agency managing the park, also describes Serrote, a hill with a lighthouse, and mangrove areas. These make interesting nature visits if your itinerary actually includes the relevant walk or excursion.

**The protected area has visiting rules.** Before traveling, check permitted roads, vehicle routes and restrictions on particular sections of the dunes. A buggy excursion does not grant permission to drive freely across the entire national park.

## Lago Azul and Lago Paraiso

Trips to **Lago Azul** and **Lago Paraiso** are among the well-known excursions from Jericoacoara. The lagoons offer a very different experience from an ocean beach, with pale sand, calmer water and open views of nearby dunes.

They are suitable for a separate half-day outing or a longer excursion. Actual water depth, road access and the order of stops can change with the seasons. An itinerary promising a "lagoon visit" therefore needs to specify which lagoons are meant and whether they are included in the paid program.

| Place | What to expect |
|---|---|
| Ocean beach | Waves, wind and walks |
| Lago Azul | Lagoon scenery |
| Lago Paraiso | Relaxing by the lagoon |
| Dunes | Walks and views |

Combining the two lagoons with the dunes makes Jericoacoara appealing for photography and nature travel. With limited time, it is better to select a few specific stops than spend most of the day in a vehicle.

## Buggy rides, horseback riding and surfing

Activities available around Jericoacoara include buggy rides, horseback riding, boat excursions and surfing. Each requires different conditions.

A buggy is suitable for a planned itinerary along permitted roads and to natural sites outside the village. Horseback riding allows for a slower exploration of stretches of the coast. Surfing and wind sports depend on wind strength, waves and skill level. Confirm specific activities with the operator and the actual program, especially if you are a beginner.

Natural attractions are protected inside the national park, so driving on dunes, wildlife watching and access to sensitive sections are subject to rules. A "buggy trip" should specify its route, not imply unlimited access to protected land.

## How to get there from Fortaleza

[Fortaleza](/brazil/place/fortaleza/) is Ceará's major city and a convenient gateway for a trip to Jericoacoara. According to ICMBio, the road from Fortaleza follows CE-085 to Jijoca de Jericoacoara, followed by the approach to the resort village. This is a substantial journey from the city to the coast and must be allowed for in your schedule.

When comparing itineraries, confirm whether transfers go directly to your accommodation, where you change to suitable transport for the last section, how baggage is handled and whether driving after dark is planned. Not all ordinary cars are equally suitable for local unpaved approaches.

You can combine several days in Fortaleza with a longer stay in Jericoacoara. This gives you access to city amenities and a separate nature experience without returning to the same hotel every evening.

## Seasons, weather and the quality of your stay

Ceará's coast has rainy periods and windier months. ICMBio states that Jericoacoara's rainy season usually falls from February through May; the rest of the year more often has sunny days and consistent winds. Nevertheless, check the weather for your particular week and sea conditions shortly before traveling.

If the lagoons are your priority, find out how full they are after the rains. For sailing and surfing, winds and waves matter most; for families with young children, look for sheltered water and the ability to alternate outings with relaxation. There is no single "best month" for every purpose.

The [Beach Holidays section](/interests/beach-holidays/) helps compare resorts, while the [Brazil tour catalog](/brazil/tour/) lists organized itineraries. Mentioning Jericoacoara as an optional destination on a tour centered on another city does not mean it is part of that tour's main route.

## How Jericoacoara differs from other resorts

Compared with [Fortaleza](/brazil/place/fortaleza/), Jericoacoara offers a more intimate vacation surrounded by natural landscapes. Compared with the [Costa do Sauípe](/brazil/place/costa-do-sauipe/) resort complex, the emphasis here is on dunes and excursions to lagoons rather than hotel facilities.

The right choice depends on the focus of your trip: the ocean and walks, active days in nature or staying within a resort. For Jericoacoara, allow enough time for both the journey and the excursions.

## Frequently asked questions about Jericoacoara

### Where is Jericoacoara?

In Ceará state, northeastern Brazil, on the Atlantic coast. The resort village is beside Jericoacoara National Park.

### Can you see the lagoons and dunes in one day?

Some programs combine several stops, but the time needed depends on the exact route, road conditions and season. Check Lago Azul and Lago Paraiso separately when choosing an excursion.

### Can buggies drive on all the dunes?

No. National park transport restrictions and conservation requirements apply. Choose a route on permitted sections that respects current rules.

### Is Jericoacoara suitable for a relaxing holiday?

Yes. You can alternate beach days, walks and lagoon excursions. Surfing and long dune outings have their own conditions and physical demands.

## Jericoacoara as a tour extension: beaches and dunes instead of Buzios

[Jericoacoara](/brazil/place/jericoacoara/) is a resort on Ceará's coast, known for sandy dunes, an ocean beach and lagoons. The village stands beside a national park, where you can walk along the shore, watch sunsets from the dunes and arrange separate nature excursions.

On our tours, Jericoacoara is offered as **a possible alternative for the beach portion** that follows the main itinerary in [Buzios](/brazil/place/buzios/). Here you will find {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} where this resort can be selected as an additional option. Its appearance among the alternatives does not mean that flights to Ceará, a Jericoacoara hotel or a buggy excursion are included in the base price.

## Which New Year tours offer Jericoacoara as an option?

The [10-day New Year Brazil tour: Rio, Iguazu and Buzios](/brazil/tour/brazil-new-year-rio-iguazu-buzios-10-days/) combines several nights in Rio, Iguazu Falls and a beach finale. The program allows the final resort to be changed, including to Jericoacoara. This is an opportunity to customize the beach portion, not a required visit to Ceará on every departure.

The [New Year Tour: Rio and Beach Holiday in Buzios](/brazil/tour/brazil-new-year-rio-buzios-beach/) has specified travel dates of **December 30, 2026 to January 8, 2027**. The core program includes three nights in Rio and six nights on the coast at Buzios. Jericoacoara in the country's northeast may be chosen instead. That change requires agreement on accommodation, domestic flights and transfers because Jericoacoara lies in another region of Brazil.

The [12-day New Year journey: Rio, Iguazu and the Amazon](/brazil/tour/brazil-new-year-rio-iguazu-amazon/) also lists Jericoacoara as a possible alternative for the final beach holiday. The program specifically requires confirmation of the chosen option. It cannot be presented as a ready-made tour with confirmed lodging in Jericoacoara unless the original itinerary is adjusted.

## How Jericoacoara differs from Buzios

| Criterion | Comparison |
|---|---|
| [Buzios](/brazil/place/buzios/) | Bays near Rio |
| [Jericoacoara](/brazil/place/jericoacoara/) | Dunes and lagoons in Ceará |
| Logistics | The second option is in a different region |

Buzios is in Rio de Janeiro state, making it easy to include in an overland continuation after exploring the city. Jericoacoara lies much farther north in Ceará. Because of the distance, a separate flight and ground transfer generally need to be arranged. This difference matters to travelers, especially over New Year when transport and accommodation can be busy.

Jericoacoara offers a different range of activities: walks over dunes, beach sports and buggy excursions to [Lagoa do Paraíso and Lagoa Azul](/brazil/place/jericoacoara/). These are natural attractions around the resort, not a guaranteed list of paid excursions for every tour. ICMBio also mentions mangrove walks, seahorse watching in the Guriú area and a visit to Pedra Furada among possibilities in and around the park.

## Getting there and how many days to allow

According to the national park administration, the road from [Fortaleza](/brazil/place/fortaleza/) to Jijoca de Jericoacoara municipality is approximately 294 km, followed by an unpaved section to the resort village. Vehicle rules apply within and around the protected area. Even after arriving by air, allow for a ground journey and changes of transport.

When replacing Buzios with Jericoacoara, consider not only the number of nights but the hours actually available: time for a domestic flight, luggage and the road may reduce the first or last beach day. Hotel choice, transfer arrangements and the excursions themselves must be specified in your customized itinerary before booking.

## When to travel and what to do there

Jericoacoara National Park is open to visitors year-round. ICMBio reports that the rainiest months usually fall between February and May. Sunny and windy days are more common during the rest of the year, making conditions attractive for kitesurfing and windsurfing, although coastal weather and sea conditions remain variable.

At the resort, you can alternate beach relaxation with lagoon trips, sandy walks and watching the sunset. For excursions within the national park, follow current conservation rules, avoid driving onto prohibited dunes and choose permitted routes. A separate active-holiday program may require extra time and expense.

For more options, see [tours in Brazil](/brazil/tour/), [beach holidays](/interests/beach-holidays/) and the pages about [Jericoacoara](/brazil/place/jericoacoara/) and [Buzios](/brazil/place/buzios/).

## Frequently asked questions about adding Jericoacoara to a tour

### Is Jericoacoara already included in New Year tour prices?

In the listed programs it is an alternative beach resort. The confirmed base stay is often in Buzios; the price of changes and any included flight must be agreed separately.

### Can you replace Buzios with Jericoacoara without a new flight?

They are different regions of Brazil. Unlike the overland transfer from Rio to Buzios, reaching Jericoacoara generally requires separate flight arrangements followed by a ground transfer.

### Which destination is better for nature walks?

Jericoacoara has broad dunes, lagoons and a national park. Buzios offers numerous beaches, bays and boat excursions. Choose based on your preferred activities and available time.

### What is the weather like over New Year?

December and January come before Jericoacoara's main rainy season, which ICMBio says generally runs from February to May. Actual weather and water-sport conditions depend on your travel dates.

## Lagoa Azul: a lake amid the white dunes of Lençóis Maranhenses

Lagoa Azul (Blue Lagoon) is in [Lençóis Maranhenses National Park](/brazil/place/lencois-maranhenses/) in northeastern [Brazil](/brazil/). It is one of the best-known parts of a system of freshwater pools that form in hollows between white sand dunes after rainfall. The contrast of pale sand and bluish water makes the landscape a recognizable symbol of Maranhão.

The natural system is constantly shifting: wind moves the sand, water gradually evaporates and lagoon levels change. Photographs of Lagoa Azul taken in different seasons can therefore look quite different. The most important thing is to plan your visit according to **the condition of the lagoons on your intended dates**, not one famous image.

## Where is Lagoa Azul and where do trips depart?

The usual base for visiting Lagoa Azul is [Barreirinhas](/brazil/place/barreirinhas/) on the [Preguiças River](/brazil/place/preguicas-river/). According to ICMBio's official description, visitors reach the **Circuito Lagoa Azul** route through an agency in Barreirinhas on accredited four-wheel-drive transport. After the road transfer, part of the journey is on foot across sand.

ICMBio describes the outing as normally taking about half a day, with the possibility of stopping to swim when conditions permit. This is a typical format, not a promise of a particular departure time or mandatory swimming on every program. We can combine Lagoa Azul with a day of dune sightseeing until sunset when the chosen itinerary allows it.

**An ordinary rental car is no substitute for accredited transport**, and unregulated independent driving across the dunes is not permitted under protected-area access rules.

## What to see on the Lagoa Azul circuit

The official route can also pass other seasonal pools besides Lagoa Azul, including Preguiça, Esmeralda and Peixe lagoons. ICMBio makes clear that these **appear and disappear** depending on rainfall, winds and changing dune formations.

The lagoons actually visited may therefore differ from a list given in advance. Do not assume that every named pool is a guaranteed stop. If a particular lagoon matters to you, check whether it is accessible, contains water and is included in the excursion you have chosen.

| Part of the route | Key detail |
|---|---|
| Drive from Barreirinhas | Accredited 4×4 |
| Dunes | Walking uphill on sand |
| Lagoons | Seasonal freshwater |
| Return | According to excursion terms |

The dunes themselves are worth exploring even without swimming: sweeping white ridges, smooth lines in the sand and unexpected contrasts between water and vegetation define the park's scenery.

## When is the best time to visit?

The pools between the dunes are filled by seasonal rainfall. Lagoons are usually fuller after the rains; later, during the dry months, some shrink or dry out. The amount of rain and timing of filling vary from year to year.

If **swimming in a lagoon** is your goal, check actual conditions shortly before departure rather than expecting a fixed depth. Even when the lagoons are full, whether swimming and access are allowed is determined by park rules and the guides.

The park can be visited year-round along permitted routes, but seeing dunes without large pools and traveling specifically to swim are different experiences. Choose the season to match your interests.

## Safety and responsible visiting

Sand gets hot in the sun, and open dune fields offer almost no shade. Bring drinking water, sun protection and footwear suitable for walking on sand. When moving along slopes, follow the guide's route and do not wander off without agreement.

Lençóis Maranhenses is a protected natural area. Do not leave litter, disturb animals or drive beyond permitted sections of the dunes. Wind can quickly change sandy landmarks, so attempts to cross large stretches of dune fields independently require special preparation and permissions.

## What to combine with Lagoa Azul

A logical option is to add a boat trip along the [Preguiças River](/brazil/place/preguicas-river/) and visits to coastal settlements to a dune day. Another is to continue to [Atins](/brazil/place/atins/) and see other accessible areas of the park. But these visits take their own time; a tour mentioning Lagoa Azul does not mean that all neighboring attractions are included.

When choosing trips through Maranhão, check geography and individual days in [Brazil tours](/brazil/tour/). Make separate arrangements for long transfers, accommodation in Barreirinhas and national park visits.

## Frequently asked questions about Lagoa Azul

### Does Lagoa Azul exist all year?

The natural hollow and place name remain, but the amount of water changes throughout the year. The lagoon fills after rain and can become much shallower in the dry season. The dunes can still be visited without large bodies of water.

### How do you get to Lagoa Azul?

From [Barreirinhas](/brazil/place/barreirinhas/) on a permitted excursion with accredited off-road transport, followed by a walk over the dunes. Confirm the precise access arrangements before departure.

### How long does the excursion take?

ICMBio's official description gives a typical duration of about half a day. Actual timing depends on the meeting point, weather and selected program.

### Can you swim in the lagoon?

Swimming may be part of an excursion under suitable conditions and when permitted. It depends on water levels and decisions by park staff and the guide.

### How is Lagoa Azul different from the rest of the park?

Lagoa Azul is a distinct attraction and route within the extensive [Lençóis Maranhenses National Park](/brazil/place/lencois-maranhenses/), which contains many other dunes, lagoons and visiting options.
